content_sections.heading: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Job Description
content_sections.text: Assistant Professor – Computer Science Exhibit academic leadership, research excellence, and a passion for teaching in advanced areas of Computer Science and Engineering. Play a vital role in shaping the curriculum. Mentor research scholars. Promote innovation and industry collaboration. Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Strong multidisciplinary knowledge in various fields of robotics. Experience in robotics system design, integration, and testing. Hands-on experience in hardware and software development. Good problem-solving and analytical skills. Resident Staff Nurse - Male Assess and monitor patients’ health conditions. Administer medications and treatments as prescribed by physicians. Record and maintain accurate patient medical records. Assist doctors during examinations and medical procedures. Provide emergency medical care when required. Educate patients and families about treatment plans and health management. Maintain hygiene, safety, and infection control standards. Support bedridden or elderly patients with daily activities. Coordinate with healthcare teams for effective patient care. Monitor vital signs such as blood pressure, pulse, temperature, and oxygen levels. Ensure medical equipment is properly maintained and sterilised.
